decision: 99% simultaneous calibration mean bands; outer interval predictions; reject family on any disjoint simultaneous holdout cell. Additional frozen sign-aligned Y midpoint test of two named alternatives on distinct holdout.
nominal_rule: bound-constrained least squares with count-weighted squared expectation residuals from the seven calibration settings, then verify the interval constraints and physicality; inconclusive if no verified feasible witness.
